messages:
mike: quick FYI — vendor sent partial H100 shipment update, 8/32 nodes delivered for PO-884.
sara: who owns rack slot mapping for PO-884? need to update reservation spreadsheet.
mike: @jia and I have the mapping but we’re waiting on network subnets from @nina.
jia: correct, holding on IPs until IPAM assigns 10.40.12.0/24 to cluster-c3.
nina: IPAM request submitted (REQ-4432). ETA tomorrow EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
sara: OK, can we reserve capacity in the console now with placeholders? finance needs numbers for the deck.
andrew: prefer to avoid hard reservations until IPs exist — placeholders can block other teams.
mike: proposal — create "soft" reservations with a 14d expiry and a staging tag; shows up in console without claiming hard capacity.
sara: that sounds fine. who will create the soft reservations?
jia: I can open the terraform PR to create the soft reservations.
mike: ping @andrew for terraform review. PR will include something like:
```
resource "redwood_capacity_reservation" "po884_c3" {
  count = 8
  model = "h100-80gb"
  soft_reservation = true
  expiry_days = 14
  tags = ["po-884","staging"]
}
```
andrew: shape looks good but add retention_policy and a cost_center tag. I’ll review tonight.
ops-bot: deploybot: terraform plan succeeded for branch feature/soft-reserve-po884 — 4 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
nina: once IPs are assigned I’ll update the reservation with actual subnets and flip soft_reservation=false.
sara: timeline check — do we have canary nodes scheduled for next Tue?
mike: earliest burn-in slot is Tue AM but PDUs need to arrive Mon. vendor updated PDU ETA to Mon noon.
jia: can someone confirm serial numbers for delivered nodes so I can update asset inventory?
mike: sent CSV to #inventory — file PO884_nodes.csv uploaded.
andrew: quick note — region-west hard quota is 512 vCPUs; soft reservations count against soft quota only. Ops to confirm if we can temporarly exceed hard quota after final vendor ack.
ops-bot: quotabot: region-west soft usage 96/1024, hard usage 416/512.
sara: action items: @jia open terraform PR (in progress), @nina update IPAM (pending), @mike confirm PDUs/serials (done), @andrew review PR (tonight). Re-sync Thu morning unless async resolves. :rocket:
mike: thanks — marking blocked on IPAM assignment.
jia: adding PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/terraform/pulls/328
andrew: reviewing now, will leave comments in the PR.
